text:
anya: Heads-up from CS: multiple tenants seeing sudden v1 traffic during the v2 deprecation banner. Seems like some clients drop the x-api-version header when the modal replays. Any quick mitigations?

tom: Confirmed in logs. Second request of a pair frequently omits `x-api-version`. Runtime treats that as v1 and falls back.

viv: Fast UX fix: change the banner CTA to a non-navigation flow and add explicit copy "Preserve headers when retrying." That reduces automatic replays. I can ship that in ~20m.

marc: Billing worry: those fallbacks count to v1 quota and will spike invoices. Can we tag runtime-detected retries so billing can zero-rate duplicates for a short window?

kira: Runtime idea: detect duplicate `X-Client-Request-Id` within 8s and, if UA indicates redwood-sdk>=1.6, prefer v2 and emit `X-Compat-Route: auto-upgrade`. Gate with FF and tenant opt-in. Pseudo: ```
route_policy:
  - name: autodetect-retry-upgrade
    when:
      missing_header: x-api-version
      recent_request_same_id_secs: 8
      ua_min: redwood-sdk/1.6.0
    action:
      prefer_route: v2
      emit_header: X-Compat-Route: auto-upgrade
      billing_tag: compat-auto
      ff: compat_auto_upgrade
```

anya: Love the tenant opt-in. Can console add a per-tenant numeric "Retry grace window (s)" and an "Auto-upgrade (safe)" checkbox under Routing -> Compatibility? Default OFF/0.

viv: Yes. I'll add the controls + copy explaining possible billing credit during early rollout.

marc: Billing: we'll accept `billing_tag=compat-auto` and zero-rate duplicates deduped within the grace window for 14 days. Need runtime to set a deterministic marker so reconciliation is easy.

tom: Observability: surface metrics: compat_auto_hits, compat_auto_promotes, v1_fallbacks_by_tenant, and a small sample of payloads (0.1%). Also index request_id in logs for fast correlating.

kira: Safety: do not change inference kernels or model variant. Only route decision. Add alert conditions: v2_p95_latency_delta>200ms or shadow_mismatch_rate>0.02% => FF off.

anya: Plan: Viv flips banner to non-retry copy now; Kira implements runtime FF + header injection; Marc implements billing zero-rate + reconciliation query; Tom wires dashboards and alerts. Rollout window today 15:00-17:00 PT, canary tenants only initially. If any alert fires, immediate rollback.

console-bot: feature_flag created: compat_auto_upgrade by kira at 1855550030

anya: Thanks. Also add a short customer note draft for CS explaining the grace window and that we'll credit accidental duplicates during the hold period. Keep it short and precise.
